What this changes, and why.

- [ ] It has tests, of what FiveM does, or needs none
- [ ] `npm run format:check`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] `docs/differences.md` says where this differs from FiveM
- [ ] It copies nothing from FiveM, or from resources that it was tested on: see [the clean room](https://github.com/DariusHQ/fiverunner/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#the-clean-room)
